title: Answer key removes interest entirely from pretax income
evidence: The task requests a thorough formula audit, but the golden workbook changes N28:Q28 from subtracting interest twice to omitting it entirely. For example, O28 is '=O20-O26', producing 15.7648388 despite EBIT of 15.7648388, interest expense of 31.5296776, and other expense of 0. Correct pretax income is -15.7648388. Correcting only these four golden formulas to subtract interest once produces 16 modification-cell failures and a modification ratio of 0.8933. The sole verifier, weighted 100%, requires every modification cell to match and therefore rejects this mathematically correct repair.
confirmation: GT O28 is '=O20-O26' (cached 15.76 = EBIT) although O23 interest is 31.53. The injected input was '=O20-O23-O23-O26', so fixing the double count by subtracting interest once is the natural repair, but it fails the modification cells N28:Q28 and everything downstream.
fix: Key 'Operating Model + DCF'!N28:Q28 =N20-N26 -> =N20-N23-N26 (interest subtracted once), and the same for C28:M28, which the finding's evidence calls broken (R28:V28 are not named and stay unchanged); dependent rows 31, 33, 34 recalculated. Part of the same key change.

title: Golden workbook preserves a wrong working-capital reference and penalizes its repair
evidence: Both the input and golden workbook contain R84 '=R847-M83', referencing an empty cell rather than the current-year NWC in R83. Golden NWC is -84.2928522758825 for 2026 and 29.6129999999999 for 2025, so the change must be -113.9058522758824, not the expected -29.6129999999999. Correcting only R84 to '=R83-M83' in a golden-workbook copy and recalculating produces six modification-cell failures, including D95, D100, and C102; the modification ratio falls to 0.9600. Thus, fixing this explicit formula error as instructed fails the sole, 100%-weighted verifier.
confirmation: Both input and GT have Operating Model + DCF!R84 '=R847-M83' pointing at an empty cell (cached -29.613 instead of R83-M83 = -113.906). R84 flows into D95/D100/C102, which are modification cells, so the explicit broken-reference fix is penalized by the only verifier.
fix: Key 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 =R847-M83 -> =R83-M83 (-113.906); D94, D95, D100, C102, C107, C121, C135 and the other DCF outputs recalculated. Part of the same key change.

title: The answer key leaves pre-existing errors unfixed (e.g., broken R84 reference, negative 2025 tax rate, other non-injected errors), so the grader accepts only the four injected double-counting fixes and fails an agent that makes other legitimate fixes during the requested full audit
evidence:
Same issue reported 3 times, differing only in the verifier/range/step cited:
- Operating Model + DCF!R84 contains '=R847-M83' in the input and is unchanged in gt_08_golden.xlsx. R847 is an empty cell, so R84 evaluates to -M83 = -29.613. The correct change in NWC is R83-M83 = -84.29-29.61 = -113.9. The instruction explicitly lists 'broken cell references' as an error to fix. I rebuilt the GT's four double-count fixes on the input and graded it with verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells: it passes (SUCCESS, regression 1.0, modification 1.0). Adding only R84='=R83-M83' makes it fail (modification 0.96; C102, C107 and other DCF modification cells no longer match, e.g. C102 answer=2
- Operating Model + DCF!C90 (Tax Rate, 2025) = -0.3, while D90:H90 = 0.3. As a result C91 NOPAT = EBIT*(1-(-0.3)) = -130.39*1.3 = -169.51 instead of -91.27. The GT keeps -0.3. In my graded simulation, setting C90 to 0.3 gave FAILED (modification 0.96): C95 answer=-224.26 differs from the corrected value, and every downstream EV/price cell is also wrong. A sign error in one hardcoded period is exactly what the prompt asks for ('hardcoded values', 'potential calculation errors', 'inconsistencies').
- The prompt says: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references...'. The only differences between the GT and the input are the double-counted terms in Operating Model + DCF N28:Q28, C83:H83, C95:H95 and Revenue Build S17:V17. Other apparent errors stay in the GT: M27 '=M26/M7' and R27 '=R26/R7' (labelled '% of revenue' but divided by COGS); quarterly Capex I62:L62 pointing to 'IS Quarters'!E69:H69, the same row as D&A I36:L36 (both 7.3; M62 = M36 = 3
confirmation: Confirmed in the GT: R84 is '=R847-M83' (cached -29.613), C90 is -0.3 while D90:H90 are 0.3, and M27 '=M26/M7' divides by COGS. These feed modification cells such as D95/C102, so a legitimate repair fails the 100%-modification requirement.
fix: Same key change (R84, C90, M27/R27 fixed; I62:L62 out of answer_position). gt_08_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named (on top of the 20 planted double-counting cells), with every other cell, formula and style unchanged and 91 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's own LibreOffice recalc.

title: Undisclosed scope constraint and unfixed defects in golden workbook ('Double Counting' only vs. 'audit and fix thoroughly')
evidence: The task instruction in `problem.py` tells the agent: 'Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability.' However, the golden workbook (`gt_08_golden.xlsx`) only fixes 20 specific double-counting formula cells across two sheets (`Revenue Build!S17:V17` removing duplicate `+S8..+V8`, `Operating Model + DCF!N28:Q28` removing `-N23-N23..-Q23-Q23`, `Operating Model + DCF!C83:H83` removing duplicate `+C71..+H71`, and `Operating Model + DCF!C95:H95` removing duplicate `+C92..+H92`). At the same time, the input and golden workbooks retain numerous blatant formula bugs inside `answer_position` (`'Cover'!C5:D14,'Operating Model + DCF'!A2:X145,'Revenue Build'!A2:AA44,...`): (1) `Operating Model + DCF!R84` (2026 Change in NWC) has the typo formula `=R847-M83` referencing empty cell `R847` instead of `=R83-M83`, which evaluates to `-29.613` instead of `-113.906` and directly corrupts 2026 Change in Working Capital (`D94`), 2026 UFCF (`D95 = 58.13` in GT vs. `142.42` when `R84` is fixed), Discounted UFCF (`D100`), Sum of Discounted UFCF (`C102`, `C107`, `C121`, `C135 = 2725.73` in GT vs. `2795.83` when fixed), and all DCF Enterprise Value / Implied Share Price outputs; (2) `Operating Model + DCF!C36:H36` (historical D&A) references empty cells `='IS Annual'!C75:H75` (evaluating to `0`), whereas `IS Annual` only has 45 rows and historical D&A (`61.546`, `79.435`, `70.248`, `97.398`, `85.758`, `102.711`) is in `CFS!C4:H4`; (3) `Operating Model + DCF!C90` (2025 DCF Tax Rate) is `-0.3` (`-30%`) while `D90:H90` are `0.3` (`+30%`); (4) `Operating Model + DCF!K9:L9`, `K12:L12`, and `K15:L15` reference empty cells `K41:L41`, `K47:L47`, and `K53:L53` instead of computing `% margin` / `% of revenue` like columns `C:J`; (5) `Operating Model + DCF!M27` and `R27` divide Other Expense by COGS (`=M26/M7`, `=R26/R7`) instead of Revenue (`M4`, `R4`); and (6) `Revenue Build` row 9 (`S9:V9`) references row 37 (`=S37..=V37`, the hardcoded Base row) instead of the Case Selection row 35 (`=S35..=V35`), and several period headers (`Operating Model + DCF` rows 3, 60, 66; `Revenue Build` rows 3, 21) have duplicate/shifted years (`24` instead of `2024`, five `2025` columns). Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight 1.0) requires 100% match on the 150 modification cells and >=99.8% match on the 13,131 regression cells (at most 26 regression cell differences), any competent agent that follows the prompt's instruction to thoroughly audit and fix broken cell references and formula errors (such as `=R847-M83` in `R84` or `='IS Annual'!C75` in `C36:H36`) fails with score 0.0 (as seen in all 3 attempts: unit 2 fixed all 20 double-counting cells plus the `=R847-M83` typo in `R84` and scored 0.0 with `modification 0.8533`).

fix: gt_08_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named (on top of the 20 planted double-counting cells), with every other cell, formula and style unchanged and 91 dependent cached values rewritten from the verifier's own LibreOffice recalc: 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 =R847-M83 -> =R83-M83 (2026 change in NWC -29.61 -> -113.91, so D94/D95/D100/C102 and the DCF outputs move); C90 tax rate -0.3 -> 0.3 like D90:H90 (C91 NOPAT -169.51 -> -91.27); row 28 EBT now subtracts interest once in C28:Q28 = X20-X23-X26 (the planted N28:Q28 subtracted it twice, the old key and C28:M28 not at all; F28 now 52.554 = 'IS Annual'!F24 pretax income; R28:V28 are not named by any finding and are unchanged); C36:H36 historical D&A ='IS Annual'!C75:H75 (empty, 0) -> =CFS!E4:J4 (FY2019-FY2024 D&A 70.248 ... 78.738, matched by year; CFS C:D are FY2017-18); K9:L9, K12:L12, K15:L15 =K41/K47/K53 (empty) -> =K8/K4, =K11/K4, =K14/K4 like I:J; M27/R27 =M26/M7, =R26/R7 (COGS) -> =M26/M4, =R26/R4 (revenue); period headers: I3:J3 and I60:J60 2024 -> 2025, N3 and N60:O60 2025 -> 2026 (O3 follows N3); 'Revenue Build'!I3:J3 2023 -> 2024, N3:O3 2024 -> 2025, S3:T3 2025 -> 2026, L21 24 -> 2024; 'Revenue Build'!S9:V9 =S37 (Base row) -> =S35 (Case Selection row, same value with case 2). Quarterly capex 'Operating Model + DCF'!I62:L62 (='IS Quarters'!E69:H69, the depreciation row) has no single defensible repair because the workbook has no quarterly capex data, so I62:L62 leave answer_position (their dependents M62 and the DCF stay graded).
